activity.notes: A Canadian Army Journal account reproduces Major's own description of his reconnaissance into Zwolle on the evening of 13 April 1945 and actions continuing into 14 April. ATLAS records only this bounded Zwolle action rather than his full wartime service.

sources.title: Canadian Army Journal, Vol. 11 No. 3
sources.citation_text: The Canadian Army Journal recounts Léo Major's reconnaissance into Zwolle on the evening of 13 April 1945 and his actions there into 14 April.
